Velgrynd's Help Grow friendship request: friendship ≥500, loyalty ≥500 and bond ≥1000; the player owns Alteration, either player or NPC owns an Uriel variant, the NPC owns Raguel, and the player's current EP is at least 2.4 million. Execution spends 2.4 million EP and directly attempts to grant Shub to the player, subject to normal acquisition cost. Cthugha goes to the NPC, consuming that NPC's Raguel and any Uriel variant it owns. On first acquiring Skill Storage, eligible permanent skills are recorded and removed from the active skill list; resistances stay, while magic, battlewill, external transfers, no-plundering skills and configured exclusions are exempt.

Azathoth's special automatic acquisition: master Raphael Wisdom and Beelzebuth, with default requirements of 100 named subordinates and 100 mastered skills; automatic evolution, Nightmare ultimates and God Skills must be enabled, configuration must allow it and god-class ownership must be available. Default EP requirement is 40 million with any owned True Dragon ultimate, otherwise 60 million; the MP threshold is max(0, 20 million − 5 million × owned True Dragon ultimates). Both prerequisite ultimates and all owned True Dragon ultimates are consumed, with the dragons recorded in Azathoth. A True Dragon ultimate is optional.

Nodens standard automatic route: own Lucifer; defaults require maximum EP ≥40 million, 150 mastered skills, at least eight copied ultimate submode entries in Lucifer, and mastered Spatial Motion and Multilayer Barrier. When configured, Raphael's Alteration mode must be analyzed; owning either full Raphael also satisfies that analysis check. Automatic evolution, Nightmare ultimates, God Skills and Nodens evolution must be enabled, with god-class ownership available. The default MP threshold is 3.4 million plus the default acquisition cost of the skill for each copied ultimate submode entry. On first acquiring Skill Storage, eligible permanent skills are recorded and removed from the active skill list; resistances stay, while magic, battlewill, external transfers, no-plundering skills and configured exclusions are exempt.

Nodens alternative automatic route: own Lucifer and have Azathoth's Soul Gluttony mode plus Shub's skill-gifting mode; each can be satisfied by the full skill or its copied submode in Lucifer. Default thresholds are maximum EP ≥30 million and MP ≥12.3 million. Automatic evolution, Nightmare ultimates, God Skills and Nodens evolution must be enabled, with god-class ownership available. Full ownership of Azathoth and Shub is not required. On first acquiring Skill Storage, eligible permanent skills are recorded and removed from the active skill list; resistances stay, while magic, battlewill, external transfers, no-plundering skills and configured exclusions are exempt.

Nodens self-Alteration menu route: Lucifer is in the preset, either Raphael's Alteration mode has been copied, and at least eight ultimate submode entries are copied; Nightmare ultimates and God Skills are enabled, ownership is available, and the Alteration menu can be opened. The menu checks base maximum MP ≥5.25 million; direct granting still charges normal Nodens acquisition cost, default 3.4 million with acquisition modifiers, then deducts another 4.25 million MP from the base maximum, reducing it no lower than zero. On first acquiring Skill Storage, eligible permanent skills are recorded and removed from the active skill list; resistances stay, while magic, battlewill, external transfers, no-plundering skills and configured exclusions are exempt.

Additional acquisition route: while permanently owning Sloth and meeting the configured mastered-skill count, default 100, the automatic update attempts to grant permanent Designer at mastery 0. Its default normal acquisition cost is 95,000 MP; Sloth remains.

Additional acquisition route: permanently own Designer and accumulate the configured time standing still on beds, default 60 minutes. Designer then automatically tries to grant permanent Sloth at mastery 0, with its normal acquisition cost. Designer remains, and movement interruptions do not reset the accumulated timer.

Bonus: when you permanently learn the source skill, you can also receive the target at mastery 0 if you do not already own it. Normal acquisition cost is waived. This bonus rule does not consume the source.
